_comment: Class-change crowding + hours (Phase 3). Weekends are off. Times are local 24-hour 'HH:MM'. FILL IN the two Duke facts: classEndTimes and academicBuildings. The crowding numbers are sensible defaults you can tune. Run `npm run build:crowding` after editing.
_comment_classEndTimes: Weekday class end times (same every weekday), each triggering a crowding spike. e.g. ['10:05','11:20','12:35']. EMPTY = crowding off.

crowding._comment: A multiplier on walking time near academic buildings: a bell that peaks peakLagS seconds AFTER each class end, spanning windowMinutes, reaching peakMultiplier at the peak, only within radiusMeters of a building.

_comment_academicBuildings: Names (must match data/processed/places.json / the place index) of academic buildings that cause crowding. EMPTY = crowding off. e.g. ['Perkins Library','Gross Hall']. Unmatched names are reported by build:crowding.
